package moba

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
)

// MatchRoute 固定 MatchID -> RoundEntityID 的唯一入口。业务为一个匹配命名空间配置同一 Directory EntityID。
// 创建 / 恢复比赛先 Reserve，再初始化返回的 Round ID；不能每次重试重新分配一局来规避幂等。
type MatchRoute struct {
	MatchID string
	RoundID int64
	Binding string
}

func RoundBinding(c Change) string {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(struct {
		Version  string
		Members  [ArenaSeats]Member
		Seed     uint64
		Deadline int64
	}{ArenaVersion, c.Members, c.Seed, c.Deadline})
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

// Directory 样例最多 64 局，不静默淘汰终态映射；业务需按赛季 / 分片设计可证明的归档边界。
func ReserveRound(raw, matchID string, candidateID int64, binding string) (string, int64, error) {
	if len(matchID) == 0 || len(matchID) > 128 || candidateID <= 0 {
		return raw, 0, ErrRule
	}
	digest, err := hex.DecodeString(binding)
	if err != nil || len(digest) != 32 {
		return raw, 0, ErrRule
	}
	routes := []MatchRoute{}
	if raw != "" {
		if err := strictJSON([]byte(raw), &routes); err != nil {
			return raw, 0, err
		}
	}
	for _, route := range routes {
		if route.MatchID == matchID {
			if route.Binding != binding {
				return raw, 0, ErrRule
			}
			return raw, route.RoundID, nil
		}
		if route.RoundID == candidateID {
			return raw, 0, ErrRule
		}
	}
	if len(routes) >= 64 {
		return raw, 0, ErrRule
	}
	routes = append(routes, MatchRoute{matchID, candidateID, binding})
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(routes)
	return string(encoded), candidateID, nil
}
